{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '*.rst'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '*.rst'
  # Allow manual workflow triggering from the "Actions" tab.
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    environment: test

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres@sha256:52e6ffd11fddd081ae63880b635b2a61c14008c17fc98cdc7ce5472265516dd0
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          # Make accessible on localhost.
          - 5432:5432

      redis:
        image: redis@sha256:1f073813b641755b70b0200da64131bbeeb4ec5b633ca67772229b49820caafa
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          # Make accessible on localhost.
          - 6379:6379

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.13", "3.14"]

    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
      with:
        persist-credentials: false

    - name: Install uv and Python
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@bec219d24cd3e171d82865faccec33120bb574f4 # v10.1.0
      with:
        enable-cache: auto
        cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Install project
      run: uv sync --frozen --only-group test

    - name: Test with pytest and coverage
      env:
        POSTGRES_HOST: localhost
        POSTGRES_USER: postgres
        POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
        POSTGRES_DB: postgres
        PYTEST_ADDOPTS: "--color=yes"
      run: |
        uv run coverage run --source=byceps -m pytest tests

    - name: Generate XML output from test coverage
      if: github.repository == 'byceps/byceps' && github.ref_name == 'main'
      run: |
        uv run coverage xml

    - name: Upload coverage to Qlty
      uses: qltysh/qlty-action/coverage@c9b09987143d1e4ac955f4803c7bea742102feb5 # v2.4.0
      if: github.repository == 'byceps/byceps' && github.ref_name == 'main'
      with:
        oidc: true
        files: coverage.xml

    - name: Post result to Discord
      # Run job even if build is cancelled.
      if: always() && github.repository == 'byceps/byceps' && github.ref_name == 'main'
      env:
        PYTHON_VERSION: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        JOB_RESULT: ${{ job.status }}
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL }}
      run: uv run ./.github/workflows/send-workflow-result-to-discord.py --result $JOB_RESULT --webhook-url $DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs on push and pull_request to main with no concurrency control, so when a new revision is pushed while a previous run is still executing, both runs consume CI resources. The P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern supports canceling superseded runs for the same workflow and branch/PR. Adding a concurrency group keyed by github.ref with cancel-in-progress: true cancels the older run when a newer one starts, saving resources while preserving all test steps, services, matrix coverage, and required checks. This is a test workflow (not release/deployment), the group is scoped by ref to avoid cross-branch cancellation, and no required checks are configured that would be broken by cancellation.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
